title: Governance Policy
description: Header contract for policies/*.yaml — validates the universal front-matter fields (name, version, description) while allowing each policy's own body. Enforced by scripts/build_manifest.py (ADR-0003). The full policy body after the `---` is a separate markdown document and is not validated here.

effective_date.description: ISO date the policy takes effect (recommended)

constitutional_basis.description: Constitutional articles this policy derives from — prose strings or {article,name,relevance} objects (recommended)
